For more information, visit www.gf.com. Internship Program Overview: Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, youâll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. Summary of Role: GlobalFoundries is seeking an intern to support the development of AI-enabled methods for semiconductor device modeling. The intern will combine device physics, measured silicon data, simulation data, and modern AI/ML techniques to help improve model extraction, predictive accuracy, and scalable modeling workflows for CMOS and emerging devices. Essential Responsibilities include: Support the development and evaluation of machine-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, and prediction of device characteristics. Build reproducible Python-based data pipelines that combine measured device data, compact-model simulations, TCAD results, and relevant process or test metadata. Train, validate, and compare AI/ML models using appropriate baselines, holdout datasets, error metrics, uncertainty analysis, and physics-based constraints. Apply methods such as neural networks, Gaussian processes, optimization, sensitivity analysis, and physics-informed machine learning to device-modeling problems. Assist with automation of model fitting, feature extraction, hyperparameter optimization, regression testing, visualization, and reporting. Collaborate with device, characterization, compact-modeling, PDK, EDA, and circuit-design teams to translate technical requirements into usable modeling solutions. Document datasets, assumptions, model architecture, training methods, validation results, limitations, and recommended usage. Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations and present project findings to the technical team at the conclusion of the internship. Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications: Education â Actively pursuing a Masterâs or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Physics, Physics, or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. Strong written and verbal communication skills Strong planning & organizational skills Academic or project experience in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, optimization, or scientific data analysis. Experience working with structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, and reproducible analysis. About Lucid 

 At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.   

 We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. 

 The Vehicle Infotainment team develops applied AI and machine learning solutions for intelligent vehicle features and engineering applications. Our work spans computer vision, machine learning, generative AI, large language models, AI-powered engineering tools, and AI model deployment on embedded automotive platforms.   

 As an AI/ML intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to a real-world project using production-relevant data, tools, and development workflows. You will gain hands-on experience across the AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, training, evaluation, optimization, integration, and validation.   

 Role and Responsibilities 

• Based on your skills and interests, you will be matched to projects in computer vision, machine learning, generative AI and LLM applications, or edge AI.   

• Prepare datasets and develop, train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI/ML models.   

• Build Python-based AI tools, prototypes, and development workflows.   

• Improve model performance and support integration and validation in automotive or embedded environments.   

• Collaborate with engineers, document results, and present project outcomes.   
 
 Must Have Skills 

• Proficiency in Python and familiarity with libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, or OpenCV.   

• Understanding machine learning fundamentals, data preparation, model training, and evaluation.   

• Experience with at least one deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.   

• Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.   

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.   
 
 Nice to Have Skills 

• Experience with computer vision tasks such as object detection, classification, segmentation, or tracking.   

• Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI agents.   

• Familiarity with Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks.   

• Experience with C++, ONNX, Docker, model optimization, quantization, or edge AI deployment.   

• Exposure to embedded systems, automotive software, or simulation tools such as CARLA.   

 Education 

• Field(s) of study : Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related fields 

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree program at an accredited university 

• Proof of enrollment in current or into next program (MS, PhD) 

 Program Information :   

• Timing : May- August, or June-September pending class schedules.   

• Duration of Internship : Our internship program is 12 weeks; the end date is flexible based on individual needs.   

• Work Location & Environment : This position will be in Newark, CA, and is fully in-person. You must be prepared to start onsite for your first day of employment. The working environment will be a mix of lab & office work.   

• Compensation : Student compensation is based on location and current degree level, non-negotiable ranging from $53 to $72 (subject to changes).   

• Relocation : May be provided on a case-to-case basis.   

• Housing/Transportation : You must provide your own living arrangements and transportation in the local area.   

• Background Check : All offers of employment are contingent on clearing a background check.   

• Drug Screening : All offers of employment are contingent on passing a drug screen.   

• Medical benefits : Dental, vision, and medical on day 1 for all interns working full-time.   

• Visa Sponsorship : Lucid may but is not obligated to sponsor foreign national employees requiring company sponsorship for U.S employment authorization.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.
